name: icloud-mcp-connector
description: Built on Omar Shahine's MIT-licensed apple-pim and its existing stdio MCP server. Adds scoped Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and Notes tools and a local Codex plugin, with direct cloud access for dots in development.

interface.longDescription: Extends apple-pim's existing stdio MCP server with exact Mac resource/account scopes, disabled writes by default, Notes tools and a local Codex plugin. Intended to support dots through the connected Mac; direct cloud MCP access remains in development. Each user provides private scopes and approved macOS access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use my approved Mac Calendar, Reminders, Contacts and Notes scopes.
